simple.meaning: סָפַף (çâphaph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to wait at the threshold.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 84:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָפַף (H5605) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סָפַף (çâphaph) / H5605 is traced through Psalms 84:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.
